decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster fits the firm's core coolant-management business and costs little to keep. It launched only in 2023, so its value is still uncertain and the option should stay open.
The cleaning centrifuge complements the firm's filtration systems and keeping it costs little. One year of website presence reveals too little to justify abandoning it.
Coolant nozzles are a low-cost accessory line with several models that supports system sales, so holding the option is cheap.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the firm's conveyor offer with steady demand from metalworking. There is no evidence that its value will not be realized.
The magnetic belt conveyor builds on the established conveyor platform, so the extra cost of keeping it is minimal. Its prospects are still unfolding.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core product type for machine tool users, and keeping them costs little while they support the modular offering.
